header.title: Live Session Settings
header.description: Control which scheduling modes, platforms and features are available to admins when creating live classes.

toast.atLeastOnePlatform: At least one streaming platform must be allowed.
toast.saveFailed: Failed to save live session settings.
toast.googleAutoRecordSaveFailed: Settings saved, but the Google account auto-record change didn't save. Try Save again.

timezone.title: Default Timezone
timezone.description: Pre-fills the timezone field on every new live-class form. Admins can still change it per class while scheduling.

platforms.title: Allowed Streaming Platforms
platforms.description: Hidden platforms won't appear in the Live Stream Platform dropdown when admins schedule a class.
platforms.defaultPlatformDescription: Pre-selected in the "Live Stream Platform" dropdown when admins schedule a class (single and bulk). Admins can still change it per class.

recurring.title: Recurring Classes
recurring.description: Weekly recurring schedule and the per-day default class link.
recurring.weeklyScheduleDescription: Show the 'Recurring Class' radio under Single Class mode.
recurring.defaultLinkTitle: Default class link for the day
recurring.defaultLinkDescription: Show the 'Default Class Link' card inside each selected day in the recurring schedule, where admins can set a fallback link and class name shared across all sessions on that day.
recurring.disabledBecauseWeeklyOff: Disabled because Recurring weekly schedule is off.

attendanceOnly.title: Attendance Only Mode
attendanceOnly.description: For institutes that teach offline and create live classes only to record attendance.
attendanceOnly.toggleDescription: When on, learners don't see any live class (upcoming, live or past) and get no notifications about them. They only see their attendance. Instructors still get their notifications.
attendanceOnly.onWarning: Applies to all live classes of the institute, including ones already created. Learners will not be able to see or join any class.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer Video
disclaimer.description: Shown before a learner joins a class they have not attended yet, and not again once they are marked present in it. One video for every live class, including classes created automatically by a workflow.
disclaimer.showBeforeJoinTitle: Show a disclaimer before joining a class
disclaimer.showBeforeJoinDescription: When on, a learner watches the video below before joining a class they have not attended yet. Marking them present retires it for that class.
disclaimer.videoLinkHint: YouTube or any direct video URL.
disclaimer.noLinkWarning: No link set — nothing is shown to learners until you add one.

attendanceDefault.title: Recurring Attendance Default
attendanceDefault.description: Pre-fills the per-session "Daily attendance" toggle on every newly added session in a recurring schedule. Admins can still flip it per session.
attendanceDefault.countByDefaultDescription: When on, new sessions inside a recurring class start with daily attendance counting enabled.

description.title: Class Description
description.description: Whether admins can attach a rich-text description to a live class.
description.showFieldDescription: Hides the Description editor in single-class scheduling, the bulk default-description card, and the per-row description column. Existing descriptions on saved classes aren't deleted.

feedback.title: Feedback & Engagement
feedback.afterClassDescription: Shows the 'Learner Feedback Settings' card while scheduling, and presents the feedback form to learners after the session ends.
feedback.enableByDefaultDescription: Pre-fills the per-session 'Learner Feedback' toggle to ON, so new live classes collect post-session feedback unless the admin turns it off. Applies to single and bulk scheduling.
feedback.compulsoryByDefaultDescription: Pre-fills the per-session 'Make feedback compulsory' toggle to ON. When enabled, learners cannot skip the feedback form.

waitingRoom.title: Waiting Room
waitingRoom.description: Pre-fills the waiting-room behaviour and timing on new live classes (single and bulk scheduling). Admins can still change these per class.
waitingRoom.enableByDefaultDescription: New live classes start with 'Enable Waiting Room or Pre-Joining' turned on.
waitingRoom.footnote: The type and timing apply whenever the waiting room is enabled on a class — even if it isn't enabled by default above.

bbb.title: Vacademy Meet Recording & Controls
bbb.description: Defaults applied when a live class is hosted on Vacademy Meet. Other platforms ignore these. Admins can still change them per class (single and bulk scheduling).
bbb.recordByDefaultDescription: New Vacademy Meet classes start with recording turned on.
bbb.autoStartRecordingDescription: Begin recording automatically when the meeting starts.
bbb.disabledBecauseRecordingOff: Disabled because recording is off by default.
bbb.muteOnStartDescription: Everyone except the host joins muted.
bbb.webcamsOnlyModeratorDescription: Restrict webcam sharing to the moderator/host.
bbb.listenOnlyDescription: Participants can hear the class but can't turn their microphone on. Recommended for large lectures and webinars, where open mics are the main source of avoidable server load.
bbb.disableCamTitle: Participants can't turn on their camera
bbb.disableCamDescription: Only the host's camera can be on. Recommended alongside listen-only mode for lecture-style classes.
bbb.guestPolicyDescription: How guests are admitted when they try to join the class.
bbb.disablePrivateChatTitle: Participants can't private message each other
bbb.disablePrivateChatDescription: Blocks private chat between participants. The host can still message anyone.
bbb.disablePublicChatTitle: Participants can't send messages in class chat
bbb.disablePublicChatDescription: Participants can read the class chat but not type in it. The host can still send messages.
bbb.disableSharedNotesDescription: Participants can view the shared notes but not change them.
bbb.hideUserListTitle: Participants can't see who else is in the class
bbb.hideUserListDescription: Hides the participant list from everyone except the host.
bbb.endWhenNoModeratorTitle: End class automatically after the host leaves
bbb.endWhenNoModeratorDescription: The class ends about 10 minutes after the last host leaves, so it never runs unattended.

zoom.title: Zoom Meeting Controls
zoom.description: Defaults pre-filled in the Zoom settings panel when a single class is hosted on Zoom with a connected account. Admins can still change them per class. (Bulk scheduling doesn't provision Zoom meetings.)
zoom.waitingRoomDescription: Participants wait until the host admits them.
zoom.joinBeforeHostDescription: Participants can enter before the host starts the meeting.
zoom.authenticationDescription: Only authenticated Zoom users can join.
zoom.approvalDescription: How registrations are approved for the meeting.
zoom.hostVideoDescription: The host's camera turns on automatically.
zoom.audioDescription: Which audio methods participants can use.
zoom.breakoutRoomDescription: Allow splitting participants into breakout rooms.
zoom.focusModeDescription: Participants only see the host and shared content.
zoom.multipleDevicesDescription: A participant can be signed in from more than one device.
zoom.watermarkDescription: Overlay each participant's identity on shared content.
zoom.autoRecordingDescription: Whether and where the meeting is recorded automatically.

googleMeet.title: Google Meet Controls
googleMeet.description: Defaults pre-filled in the Google Meet panel when a single class is hosted on Google Meet with a connected account. Admins can still change them per class. (Bulk scheduling doesn't create Meet links.)
googleMeet.noAccount: Connect a Google Workspace account in Google Meet Integration above to turn on auto-recording.
googleMeet.autoRecordDescription: Recording starts by itself when the organizer or a teacher on the institute's Google Workspace joins. Saved on this Google account.
googleMeet.transcriptionDescription: Google writes a transcript of the class into the organizer's Drive.
googleMeet.smartNotesDescription: Gemini writes a summary of the class into the organizer's Drive.
googleMeet.attendanceReportDescription: Google sends the organizer an attendance sheet after the class.
googleMeet.planHint: Recording and transcripts need a Workspace plan with recording (Business Standard or higher, Education Plus); Gemini notes need a Gemini licence. If the plan lacks a feature, the class is still created without it.
googleMeet.hostManagementDescription: Lets the restrictions below apply. Only the organizer account is a host; a teacher on another Google account is a participant.
googleMeet.chatHostsOnlyDescription: Learners can read the chat but not send messages.
googleMeet.presentHostsOnlyDescription: Keep this off if teachers present from their own Google accounts.
googleMeet.joinAsViewerDescription: Learners join without mic or camera.
googleMeet.disabledBecauseHostControlsOff: Disabled because host controls are off.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Default channels and triggers pre-selected when admins schedule a live class (single and bulk). Admins can still change them per class.
notifications.emailDescription: Send live-class notifications over email by default.
notifications.whatsappDescription: Send live-class notifications over WhatsApp by default.
notifications.pushDescription: Send live-class push notifications by default.
notifications.systemDescription: Send in-app system notifications by default.
notifications.onCreateTitle: When the live class is created
notifications.onCreateDescription: Fire a notification as soon as the class is scheduled.
notifications.onLiveDescription: Fire a notification the moment the class starts.
notifications.onAttendanceDescription: Notify learners when they're marked present/absent.
notifications.reminderDescription: Pre-seed one "notify before" reminder on new classes. Admins can add more or remove it per class.

customActionButton.title: Custom Action Button
customActionButton.description: An optional configurable button shown to learners on the Live Session screen.
customActionButton.cardDescription: Show the 'Custom Action Button' card while scheduling so admins can configure the button's text, URL and colors.

transcription.title: Recording Transcription
transcription.description: Generates a searchable transcript and English translation from each Vacademy Meet recording using Whisper. Costs compute per minute of audio, so this is off by default — turn on when you're ready to use transcripts for assessment generation or study notes.
transcription.buttonDescription: Adds a Process Recording action next to each recording in the live-session view so admins/teachers can kick off transcription. Existing transcripts remain viewable regardless of this setting — only the entry point to start new ones is hidden when off.

attendance.title: Minimum Attendance
attendance.description: By default a learner is marked present the moment they click Join, even if they never actually reach the class or leave after a minute. Turn this on to require that they were genuinely in the class for a share of its scheduled length. Works for Vacademy Meet and Zoom; Google Meet doesn't report who was in the room, so those classes are unaffected. A teacher's manual mark always wins, and teachers are never marked absent.
attendance.requireDescription: Applies to classes scheduled from now on. Turning it off later returns new classes to the current behaviour and never re-decides a class that already happened.
attendance.minShareDescription: Measured against the scheduled class length. A learner below this is marked absent — including anyone who clicked Join but never entered. Note a class that finishes early still measures everyone against the full scheduled slot.

lms.title: LMS Connection
lms.description: Lets teachers push live-class content into course chapters right from the session page. Off by default — turn on the features you want. Turning one off hides its entry point only; recordings and materials already added to chapters stay there.
lms.addRecordingsDescription: Shows an 'Add to course' action next to each recording on the live-session view, so teachers can link the recording into chapters of the session's batches.
lms.classMaterialsDescription: Shows the Class Materials card on the live-session view, where teachers upload a PDF or video (or paste a YouTube link) and add it to chapters.
lms.autoUploadDescription: Automatically adds a finished class recording as a slide in a chapter once it's ready — no manual 'Add to course' click needed. Sessions can pick their own destination while scheduling; otherwise the default below is used.
lms.notifyOnAutoUploadDescription: Emails enrolled learners ('New Study Material Available') when a recording is auto-added via the default destination below. Sessions with their own destination use the notify choice made while scheduling.

footer.noteSuffix: live classes scheduled after saving. Existing classes are unaffected.

visibility.title: Who can see which sessions
visibility.description: By default everyone in the institute sees every live session. Restrict a role here to limit it to its own sessions, or to the sessions of specific roles. A session's owner is its instructor list, falling back to whoever scheduled it.
visibility.modeSpecificRoles: Their own + sessions of selected roles
visibility.noRolesSelected: No roles selected yet — this behaves like 'only their own sessions'.
visibility.empty: No roles found for this institute.
visibility.multiRoleNote: A person holding several roles gets the most permissive of their rules, so a role left on 'All sessions' keeps full visibility.
